Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

Bind a target to your side completely, possibly for good.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or come completely under your sway for the duration as Utterly Devoted, and additionally cannot leave your side voluntarily for any reason (on a critical failure, the duration instead lasts until the target succeeds at a save to end it, attemptable only once per day). This is an emotion, incapacitation, and mental effect. The Claimant asks once. It is never refused twice.
